aeroagentsim.dataprovider.weather.WeatherDataProvider¶

class aeroagentsim.dataprovider.weather.WeatherDataProvider(env: Environment, config: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)[source]¶

Provides weather data and triggers weather-related events in the simulation.

__init__(env: Environment, config: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)[source]¶

Initialize the WeatherDataProvider.

Parameters:

  • env – The simulation environment instance.

  • config (dict, optional) – Configuration specific to this provider. Expected keys: - ‘api_key’: Your OpenWeatherMap API key. - ‘location’: Dict with ‘lat’ and ‘lon’. - ‘update_interval’ (optional): How often the provider checks for the next event in sim time (default: 3600). - ‘api_refresh_interval’ (optional): How often to re-fetch data from the API in real seconds (default: 3600). Set to 0 or None to disable refresh. Defaults to None.

Expected keys: - ‘api_key’: Your OpenWeatherMap API key. - ‘location’: Dict with ‘lat’ and ‘lon’. - ‘update_interval’ (optional): How often the provider checks for the next event in sim time (default: 3600). - ‘api_refresh_interval’ (optional): How often to re-fetch data from the API in real seconds (default: 3600). load_data()[source]¶

Load weather data by fetching from the OpenWeatherMap API using the adapter. Populates the internal _weather_schedule.

start_event_triggering()[source]¶

Start the SimPy process(es) to trigger WeatherChanged events based on the schedule and optionally refresh data from the API periodically.

on_weather_changed(subscriber: Any, event_data: Dict[str, Any])[source]¶

Standard callback for WeatherChanged events. Modifies the subscriber’s state based on weather conditions in their region.

Parameters:

  • subscriber – The object that subscribed to the event (e.g., Agent, LandingManager).

  • event_data (dict) – The data associated with the WeatherChanged event. Expected keys: ‘timestamp’, ‘region’, ‘wind_speed’, etc.

is_in_region(position: Tuple[float, float, float], region_data: Dict[str, Any]) → bool[source]¶

Check if a 3D position (agent’s position) is within the weather region. Currently, the API adapter provides a point region {‘lat’: …, ‘lon’: …, ‘type’: ‘point’}. This implementation assumes the weather affects a certain radius around the point.

Parameters:

  • position – Agent’s position, e.g., (x, y, z) in simulation coordinates.

  • region_data – Weather event region data, e.g., {‘lat’: …, ‘lon’: …, ‘type’: ‘point’}.

Returns:

True if the agent is considered within the affected region, False otherwise.

get_weather_at(position: Tuple[float, float, float]) → Dict[str, Any][source]¶

Get the current weather conditions at a specific position in the simulation.

Parameters:

position – A tuple (x, y, z) representing the position in simulation coordinates.

Returns:

A dictionary containing weather data for the specified position. If no weather data is available, returns a default weather data dictionary.
